"Today, I felt like I was drowning in a sea of deadlines and exams. I've been putting off studying for my psychology test, and now I'm worried I won't be prepared. To manage my stress, I'm going to start by breaking down my study plan into smaller, manageable chunks. I'll also make time for exercise and meditation to clear my mind. By taking control of my schedule and prioritizing self-care, I'm confident I can stay on top of my work and feel more calm and focused."
